text: Show that entropy is maximised by uniformity, by measuring three distributions over four symbols. Fill in the three blanks.
choices: // Using the H(String) method from earlier, compute the entropy of:
// The results are 2.0000, 1.7500 and 0.3373 bits per character.
explanation: Verified: 2.0000, 1.7500, 0.3373. The uniform case is exactly log2(4), and it is the largest entropy four symbols can have — the hardest thing to predict is the thing with no pattern. The third is a source you can almost always guess, so a symbol from it teaches you almost nothing, and a compressor can encode it in about a third of a bit each.
